report:
Independently reassessed the complete prohibition claim and all two ordinary implementation entries and four ordinary tests. Exact byte comparisons against historical implementation_sources and test_sources confirmed unchanged contracts.rs, validate.rs, contracts test file and runtime_contracts test file; the historical rationale remains sufficient after current source inspection, rather than serving as an automatic approval. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist.
resolve_contracts resolves prohibition targets (including inherited rules) separately from permissions and preserves the declaring operation, file and span. ContractSession checks every active ancestor's matching prohibitions on both requests and validation executions, after the independent immediate-caller check; an immediate permission cannot suppress a prohibition. Receiver restrictions are respected, with missing identity recorded as a nonconforming coverage gap. violation retains the full active path plus offending invocation and the original rule; finish marks violations nonconforming and assert_calls_conform exposes an error outside callbacks.
reports_direct_and_ancestor_violation_with_complete_path_and_rule asserts nonconformance, both undeclared and forbidden errors, the root rule, complete Root/Helper/Leaf path and leaf receiver. immediate_permission_does_not_override_an_active_ancestor_prohibition explicitly permits the helper's leaf request yet asserts exactly one forbidden error, ancestor rule and complete path. internal_reexecution_cannot_bypass_an_active_ancestor_prohibition checks validation execution beneath Root, a single forbidden error, rule owner, validation frame and execution message. real_salsa_contract_fixture directly asserts generated reports for cold and cached leaf requests, the forbidden target, nonconformance, rule owner and complete path; it also proves the warm leaf was reused without execution. Captured setup helpers, fixture queries/model, fixture evidence producer, expected forbidden trace and Salsa adapter confirm these are actual observed reports, not fabricated evidence. These assertions would detect skipping ancestors, letting direct permission override a prohibition, losing path/rule provenance, or omitting validation/cache observations.
Execution distinction: I ran review start/read, exact-source comparison commands and review record; I did not execute behavioral tests or a workspace build. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional sage-meta tests and successful root cargo build are separate baseline execution evidence, not my own runs. No requested edits.
